note: The sites where the Application Runner may create an account when a fill pauses for a sign-in and the owner has none (#1230). Edit this file to extend it; a host that is not listed here is never touched. Every entry is OFF unless `enabled` is true, and the whole feature is OFF unless the owner turns on `accountCreation` in the Runner's settings.

hosts.reason: Signs in with an emailed code (#1106); an account is created the same way.
